title: Satan and his angels cast down to Earth before Adam
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Satan and his angels cast down to Earth before Adam, about pre-Adamic at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they came to the earth or were cast down to the earth a long time ago after that cosmic battle.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes a belief that Satan and his angels came to Earth, or were thrown down to it, long ago after a great battle in the heavens. In his telling this happened before Adam, the first man in the Bible. If true, it would mean other beings were on Earth before humanity.
